name: Incident Response Playbook
description: A short incident-response sequence for triage, containment, communication, and follow-up.
input_summary: An outage, degradation, or operational alert.
output_summary: Ordered incident response priorities and evidence requirements.
content: Confirm impact and scope, establish an incident owner, preserve evidence, contain the failure with reversible actions, communicate known facts and uncertainty, then document remediation and follow-up owners.
